data.text:
You are Worker A. Your job is to audit the repository `OS-Advisory_Conseil-SO` at `https://github.com/canada-ca/OS-Advisory_Conseil-SO` and write a JSON file to `/workspace/facts_OS-Advisory_Conseil-SO.json` with the following exact fields and allowed values only. Use the GitHub API and HTML pages. Prefer public HTML page scraping to avoid rate limits. If using API, add `sleep 1` between requests. If you cannot determine a value, write exactly `Unknown`. Never derive a column from another `Unknown` column.

Fields to determine:
1. `repo_name`: `OS-Advisory_Conseil-SO`
2. `repo_url`: `https://github.com/canada-ca/OS-Advisory_Conseil-SO`
3. `primary_language`: The language GitHub reports as primary (from API `language` field). If null, write `Unknown`.
4. `readme_exists`: Check if a README file exists (API endpoint `contents` for root). Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`Unknown`.
5. `licence`: Check the license via API `license.spdx_id` or by reading the LICENSE file. If none or undetermined, `Unknown`. Use short name like `MIT`, `Apache-2.0`, `OGL-Canada`, etc.
6. `contributing_guide`: Check if `CONTRIBUTING.md` exists at repo root (via API). Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`Unknown`.
7. `has_security_scanning_in_ci`: Check GitHub Actions workflows. If no `.github/workflows` directory or no workflow files, write `No CI`. If workflow files exist, check the GitHub Actions tab for run history. If zero runs ever (e.g., Actions disabled), write `No CI`. If runs exist but none include a security scanner (CodeQL, npm audit, pip-audit, Snyk, Trivy), write `No`. If at least one run includes a scanner, write `Yes`. Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`No CI`/`Unknown`.
8. `has_tests_in_ci`: Same logic but look for test steps (pytest, jest, npm test, go test). Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`No CI`/`Unknown`.
9. `dependency_update_policy`: Check for `.github/dependabot.yml` or Renovate config. If found and configured for the right ecosystem, write `Automated`. Else if there are dependency update commits but no config, write `Manual`. Else `None`. Allowed: `Automated`/`Manual`/`None`/`Unknown`.
10. `last_commit_date`: Date of the most recent commit on the default branch (from API `commits` endpoint or `commit.committer.date`). Format `YYYY-MM-DD`.
11. `days_since_last_commit`: Integer days since that date (from 2026-07-13). If `last_commit_date` is `Unknown`, write `Unknown`.
12. `maintained`: `Yes` if `days_since_last_commit` <= 365, else `No`. If `days_since_last_commit` is `Unknown`, write `Unknown`.
13. `open_issues_count`: Count actual open issues, not pull requests. Use the API `issues?state=open` and filter out items where `pull_request` key is present. Allowed: integer or `Unknown`.

The objectives of the Board will be two-fold. First, to have a discussion at the executive level about the most effective use and integration of open source tools into the GC to help advance our digital goals. Second, to help identify and resolve the most significant barriers to using open source tools (eg. procurement, cultural, and infrastructure challenges).
